origin: Mark, attended 2026-11-12: existing 3D map integration, telescope and object-inspection enhancements; non-commercial game. 'ok continue' advances to concrete sprint planning; this new plan awaits approval.

rulings.placement: Navigation station and captain-command Navigation; instant read-only information entry

velocity.basis: Conservative planning assumption, not measured solo throughput. Seven-day non-merge code/test churn +4126/-417 over 126 file-change entries is team/branch activity. Original telescope-related five-file slice +249/-15; data proof and review add uncertainty.

registry_reuse.reason: Source curation and image-file proof. Registry searches wcs/csv returned no package; hips returned unrelated decisions. Shell downloads and Godot image I/O.
Existing frames/rotation helpers reused; registry info/docs at 0.6.1 list no TAN/WCS helper. Add supported projection to celestial before a Godot mirror; publish then pin actual version.
Use TS1 published coordinate helpers in deterministic observation indexing; retain current stdlib/project parsing patterns.
Godot image tiling and bounded cache are engine I/O; searched celestial/observe are not image codecs; no HiPS client in this scope.
Presentation-only exact-ID focus adapter over existing Godot map/body records, with no new scientific capability.
Reuse existing surface data and physical renderer/relativity uniforms. No new optical model or stellar stop geometry.
Godot UI composition and controls; shared projection maths is contributed in TS1 rather than duplicated in a UI package.
Reuse frame/projection output through SkyFrame for direction-only survey context; no cosmological conversion.
Existing sim-supplied light age and body/catalogue data remain authoritative; formatting adds no new physical calculation.
Reuse station/chair screen hosts and read-only information panels, with no agent or simulation package.
Reuse current content-addressed asset/export infrastructure and Godot file I/O; no fresh library capability.
Targeted evidence, independent evaluation, visual acceptance and landing; no new package functionality.

registry_audit.result: Reuse celestial/observe. Contribute TAN projection to celestial if still absent at TS1; no suitable CSV/WCS/HiPS package found. No dependency was installed or upgraded by planning.

features.description: Prove real image/catalogue access, rights, supported registration and two zoom levels
acceptance_criteria: AC1: real supported registered field, real associated source rows, original schema and query preserved
Five independent registration anchors within one source pixel and two actual zoom levels verified
Sources, dates, rights, credits, hashes and sizes recorded; malformed source controls fail
make observation-pack-verify succeeds after explicit bounded downloads; no synthetic science substitution

features.description: Contribute supported celestial TAN projection with independent astrometric oracle and Godot mirror
acceptance_criteria: AC3: centre, anchors, wrap, poles and unsupported/singular cases checked against independent coordinates within 0.1 source pixel
Package check/tests/quality and strict probe parity pass before additive release and deliberate pin/lock update
make observation-coordinate-test succeeds; touched shared-frame checks pass make physics
No only-copy formula in Godot and no unrelated package upgrade

features.description: Build deterministic AILANG observation index with exact identities, provenance and nullable measured facts
acceptance_criteria: AC2/7: long IDs stay strings; missing, candidate and inferred values retain source/method/epoch
Non-finite, duplicate and ambiguous associations rejected/reported without corrupting star truth
make observation-import-test observation-import-parity succeed on real subset and labelled malformed fixtures
Repeated generated index and pure strict VM/interpreter probe output are byte-identical

features.description: Generate offline tiled mip pyramid and implement bounded visible-tile loading
acceptance_criteria: AC9/11: Godot tiling preserves seams, masks and known source crops with deterministic hashes
GPU/CPU/mip memory stays within 128 MiB/64 MiB; compressed starter within 100 MiB
Stale/cancelled/corrupt/missing/pack-mismatch loads have explicit states and no full-plate pan decode
make telescope-cache-test succeeds; runtime needs no network service

features.description: Separate read-only object focus from route planning and add exact map handoff references
acceptance_criteria: AC4: catalogue/body/survey round trips preserve identity, map camera and route state
Actual queue/intents show no additional plan/commit/cancel/approach/leave/time intent while observing
make telescope-map-test succeeds for active and committed real-sim journeys
Calling preselect instead of read-only focus is a killed mutation

features.description: Expose visible Telescope action and explicit selected-star targeting while preserving the live renderer
acceptance_criteria: AC5/6: explicit target honoured; missing/hidden explicit target never falls back to another star
Legacy fallback only without requested target and whole-disc/close/off cycle preserved
make telescope-live-test star-surface-test stellar-protocol-test succeed
Physical uniform/normaliser/resolution behaviour retained and targeted telescope-golden cases added

features.description: Build image-led archive panel with real observation pan/zoom, angular scale, dates and registered picking
acceptance_criteria: AC6/7/8: actual Euclid source image browses at available levels with resolution/missing states
Archive pixels and registered overlays stay invariant across ship location/velocity/GR
Only registered catalogued sources can be picked; overlaps use exact-ID chooser
make telescope-ui-test and initial object-inspection-test pass; input zoom/pan uses real dispatch

features.description: Add labelled survey-direction context to the existing map without invented depth or journey targets
acceptance_criteria: AC3/4: shared SkyFrame orientation and exact survey references, depth-not-shown label, real registered footprints
Survey objects never have plot/commit actions, even with a published distance
Local star xyz and local map camera survive context switch; unregistered plates do not paint footprints
make telescope-map-test observation-coordinate-test starmap-consistency pass; navigation-guard mutant is killed

features.description: Unify object facts, image availability and source cards across catalogue, live body and survey records
acceptance_criteria: AC7: measured/inferred/assumed/modelled and unknown/candidate facts remain explicit
Catalogue distances/magnitudes, ship-now values and survey dates/redshifts are never conflated
Star/body/galaxy/no-image/no-distance example matrix yields consistent facts from every entry
make object-inspection-test ship-star-identification-test pass without finder evidence/schema changes

features.description: Integrate one telescope panel into Navigation, chair screens and immediate read-only I/M entry
acceptance_criteria: AC8/11: visible controls work through actual station/chair projected clicks and keyboard/pad/typing/pinch dispatch
I/M read-only access never relocates captain or issues decisions; clocks continue
Close/stand/system-switch/escape release input and suspend renderer with one active panel/callback set
make telescope-ui-test telescope-map-test captain-command-test chair-cockpit-test ship-console-test pass

acceptance_criteria: AC9/12: three curated plates and at least one registered field ship with credits and pinned manifest/version
Offline export opens real archive and live star; corrupt/missing/pinned-version cases retain usable map/live view
make observation-assets-check telescope-export-smoke telescope-cache-test export-filter-audit uid-guard python-guard pass
